blocks.orig: In this two-day hike, you walk from Ngorongoro’s Empakaai Crater to the mesmerizing Lake Natron, guided by local Maasai, a park ranger and some donkeys for your luggage. The first day takes you through a wonderful deserted landscape and some very remote Maasai villages, after which you spend the night in a tent your guides set up for you. The next day, you walk past the volcano Ol Doinyo Lengai to the flocks of flamingos at Lake Natron. An extraordinary experience!
